value.rationale: For unrestricted higher-order ecology model design, distinguishes necessity of arity diversity from mere large arity: every singleton degree fails on a fully competitive baseline, while any two allowed distinct orders yield any prescribed local decay margin. Sharp minimality and a finite-time escape obstruction answer a natural model capability gap beyond the motivating (2,3) example. Restricted coefficient-sign or no-repeat ecological models lie outside scope.
